<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="ניסן_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917980_theRebbe_758" batchId="meluket-_D7_A0_D7_99_D7_A1_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917980_theRebbe_758__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The purpose of the tzimtzum is to enable the revelation of Ein Sof to also be in the worlds, and this is explained through the distinction between the simple perception of G-dliness and the renewed perception, as seen in prophecy and wisdom.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, it is known</t>
    <t s="2">that the intent of the tzimtzum is so that the revelation of Ein Sof will also be in the worlds.</t>
    <t s="3">For before the tzimtzum,</t>
    <t s="4">when Ein Sof filled the place of the void,</t>
    <t s="5">it was impossible for the existence of the worlds to be,</t>
    <t s="6">and consequently there was no revelation in the worlds,</t>
    <t s="7">and through the tzimtzum it was innovated that the revelation of Ein Sof will also be in the worlds.</t>
    <t s="8">And this will be understood by first prefacing what is known</t>
    <t s="9">(regarding the concealment of the tzimtzum,</t>
    <t s="10">how the light without end was concealed and included in its source),</t>
    <t s="11">that before the tzimtzum,</t>
    <t s="12">when Ein Sof filled the place of the void</t>
    <t s="13">(meaning that the Ein Sof without end shone in it)</t>
    <t s="14">G-dliness was in a state of simplicity and existence was in a state of renewal,</t>
    <t s="15">and through the removal of the light,</t>
    <t s="16">existence became in a state of simplicity and G-dliness in a state of renewal.</t>
    <t s="17">And regarding the distinction between these two matters in the service of man,</t>
    <t s="18">there are several levels.</t>
    <t s="19">In general, it is the distinction between seeing G-dliness and comprehending G-dliness.</t>
    <t s="20">For when the knowledge of G-dliness is in a manner of seeing,</t>
    <t s="21">even in the vision of wisdom and all the more so in the vision of prophecy, which is actual seeing,</t>
    <t s="22">the knowledge is in a state of simplicity, requiring no proofs or evidence for it,</t>
    <t s="23">unlike when the knowledge of G-dliness is from the compulsion of the intellect,</t>
    <t s="24">it is in a manner of renewal.</t>
    <t s="25">But in detail,</t>
    <t s="26">the matter of G-dliness in simplicity will be in the future,</t>
    <t s="27">unlike now, where even the revelation of prophecy is in a manner of renewal.</t>
    <t s="28">For in physical matters, anyone can see and there is no wonder in it at all,</t>
    <t s="29">unlike the matter of prophecy, which is specifically for one who is worthy of it,</t>
    <t s="30">for prophecy only rests upon one who is great in wisdom, mighty in his character traits, etc.,</t>
    <t s="31">and so too with the vision of wisdom, which is only for unique individuals,</t>
    <t s="32">thus the revelation of prophecy now is in a manner of novelty and not in a manner of simplicity,</t>
    <t s="33">and this is what is said about him, that it is a novelty that he is a prophet.</t>
    <t s="34">And this is because the entirety of revelation now,</t>
    <t s="35">even the revelation of prophecy,</t>
    <t s="36">is from the light of the line that came after the tzimtzum.</t>
    <t s="37">Unlike in the future, when the revelation will be of the Ein Sof that preceded the tzimtzum,</t>
    <t s="38">prophecy will be like a completely natural thing,</t>
    <t s="39">therefore it will be in every person,</t>
    <t s="40">even in boys and girls,</t>
    <t s="41">as it is written,</t>
    <t s="42">"I will pour out My spirit upon all flesh, and your sons and your daughters will prophesy."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The vision of G-dliness in the Holy Temple was accessible to all, yet it was not entirely natural like physical sight, whereas in the future it will be completely natural.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And similarly was the vision of G-dliness that was in the Holy Temple,</t>
    <t s="2">that the revelation of vision in the Holy Temple was in every person,</t>
    <t s="3">"Every male shall appear,"</t>
    <t s="4">is because in the Holy Temple the revelation of Ein Sof that preceded the tzimtzum shone,</t>
    <t s="5">but nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="6">even the revelation of the Holy Temple was not like a completely natural thing.</t>
    <t s="7">For since the revelation was only in the Holy Temple</t>
    <t s="8">[and not like seeing physical things, which requires no special place],</t>
    <t s="9">it is understood,</t>
    <t s="10">that this vision of G-dliness in the Holy Temple was due to some cause,</t>
    <t s="11">due to the revelation of Ein Sof that shone in the Holy Temple,</t>
    <t s="12">unlike in the future,</t>
    <t s="13">the vision of G-dliness will be like a completely natural thing,</t>
    <t s="14">as it is written,</t>
    <t s="15">"And all flesh will see," etc.,</t>
    <t s="16">for the properties of the eyes of flesh</t>
    <t s="17">will be in such a manner that they will see G-dliness.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Although the revelation of Ein Sof and the existence of worlds are opposites, the inner purpose of the tzimtzum is for revelation, and this is actualized through the service of Israel, especially in exile.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And it must be understood,</t>
    <t s="2">the revelation of Ein Sof without end and the existence of the worlds are two opposites,</t>
    <t s="3">therefore when Ein Sof filled the place of the void it was impossible for the worlds to come into being, and in order for there to be a place for the worlds, the removal of the light was necessary,</t>
    <t s="4">and since the coming into being of the existence of the worlds is specifically from the removal of the light</t>
    <t s="5">(the opposite of the matter of revelation),</t>
    <t s="6">how is it possible that the existence of the worlds</t>
    <t s="7">(and all the more so the existence of physical flesh)</t>
    <t s="8">will be in a manner that in its existence there will be a revelation of G-dliness?</t>
    <t s="9">And the explanation of this is,</t>
    <t s="10">that since the intent of the tzimtzum is for the sake of revelation</t>
    <t s="11">(that the revelation will also be in the existence of the worlds,</t>
    <t s="12">as above),</t>
    <t s="13">therefore the innerness of the tzimtzum</t>
    <t s="14">[and consequently also the worlds that came into being from the tzimtzum]</t>
    <t s="15">does not contradict revelation,</t>
    <t s="16">and on the contrary,</t>
    <t s="17">this is</t>
    <t s="18">(the matter of revelation)</t>
    <t s="19">the inner matter of the tzimtzum.</t>
    <t s="20">But in order to reveal the innerness of the tzimtzum,</t>
    <t s="21">this is accomplished through the service of Israel, and specifically in the time of exile</t>
    <t s="22">(as will be explained in section 9).</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
